data.title: Receipt crashes with NameError
story: Every time a cashier presses Print Receipt, the app crashes.
Run the tests and read the last line of the error. NameError means Python met a name that was never created.

explanation: The error NameError: name 'totl' isn't defined points to a typo, because the variable that was created is called total. The last line of an error always tells you the kind of problem and the name involved.
hints: Run the tests, then read the very last line of the error.
Which name does the error mention? Was that name ever created in this function?
Change return totl to return total.
